notes: The minifigure (hat, torso, legs) is not in the parts list, so it is not recorded as nodes.

Pages show only pictures, so which pieces touch is partly inferred. Piece placement for steps 4-8 (tiles, trans-red plates, clip plates, hinge plate, curved brick, seat, steering stand, bar) is estimated from small drawings.
The shovel, jackhammer and cone are assumed to be added in step 11 (clips to tool bars, cone on the bar's stud). The jackhammer is not clearly visible in the pictures.
The Plate 2x2 (3022) is never clearly shown. It is assumed to sit between the two 2x2 bricks in step 8, joined to the base.
Each wheel/tyre pair is treated as one wheel on a wheel-holder pin. Each 6157 carries two wheels.
